Subject: Your wrongful termination matter - Complaint No. 1095/2021

Dear Ms. Trivedi,

Thank you for meeting us on 24/07/2022 about your dispute with M/s Gokhale Pharma Ltd. As we understand it, the employer withheld the last salary. The matter is listed before the Madurai Labour Court.

Our advice is to file a claim for unpaid wages before the labour authority. Please collect the attendance record and the salary slips and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
